name: Relative Hitting Size of Singletons
proof: For target $\{i\}$ the translated family consists of the empty set and the pairs $\{i,j\}$ with $j\ne i$. Hitting size ignores the empty member. If $n=1$ there are no nonempty members to hit, so the value is zero. If $n\ge2$, at least one pair must be hit, and the one-point set $\{i\}$ hits every pair. Maximizing over targets gives one.
